verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own site says you can 'run Ubuntu alongside' Windows. Its documentation also covers installer topics tied to coexisting with Windows, such as BitLocker and Intel RST during Ubuntu installation. However, no evidence describes the dual-boot partitioning flow or boot-menu setup, so coverage is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: a documented step-by-step dual-boot procedure (partition resizing, the 'install alongside' option, bootloader/GRUB OS selection), coverage of non-Windows host OSes, and independent hands-on corroboration of a successful dual-boot install.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install the OS alongside my existing OS in a dual-boot configuration

citations.quote: It's easy to install in place of Windows, or run Ubuntu alongside it.
BitLocker during Ubuntu installation • Turn off BitLocker in Windows • Intel RST during Ubuntu installation • Reconfigure Windows to use AHCI
Installation: Create a bootable USB stick • Install Ubuntu Desktop
